WheelbarrowParking.art_brief: Empty parking frame, dark timber and wheel ruts. No vehicle, wheelbarrow, cargo or character baked into the image. Separate real vehicle remains visible.

SandPile.art_brief: Low broad ochre sand mound, a few large planes and restrained rough strokes. Infinite source: no depletion stages. Dedicated building artwork, never an item icon replacement.

BonePile.art_brief: Low mound of a few large weathered bones, readable joints and gaps, muted ivory planes. Distinct from sand and an upright lamp. No item icon replacement.

OutdoorLamp.art_brief: Bone support and rusty iron cage. Off/on share exactly the same alpha silhouette, canvas and ground anchor; only the cage interior changes illumination. No external glow halo or logical light baked into terrain.
